Burswood, Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 7/07/2026 to 4/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17492
- Residential, commercial, and public landscape projects
- Remuneration package - $79,500 - $85,000 + super
- Join LD Total - Position based in Burswood

About the role

LD Total is a multi-award winning landscape company specialising in landscape architecture services, irrigation design, commercial landscape construction, maintenance and residential lot packages. 

At LD Total, our design team play an active role in shaping the company and the landscape with the focus on quality and innovative design and delivery of projects. 

In order to support the continued growth of our business in WA, LD Total is seeking appointment of a Landscape Architect to assist in providing fully integrated Landscape Architecture design and delivery of master planned land development communities including public open spaces, public sector projects, playgrounds, industrial estates, urban projects, and ecological projects.

There is the opportunity to further develop your professional and technical knowledge in all aspects of the landscaping industry through regular team building and social / professional networking events and UDIA / AILA affiliations.

As a Design & Construct company we work alongside our construction team to ensure our landscape vision hits the ground. This means more time to design and work with our clients and less time spent undertaking contractual tasks. We work with a range of clients in Perth, from the large diversified property groups through to smaller developers and builders. 

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop landscape architecture concepts for residential, commercial, and public projects
- Prepare design documentation, including plans, specifications, and reports
- Collaborate with clients, engineers, planners, and other stakeholders
 -Conduct site analysis, feasibility assessments, and environmental impact considerations
- Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables
- Ensure compliance with Australian standards, planning regulations, and sustainability principles

Skills and Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Landscape Architecture or a closely related field
- Minimum 12 months relevant work experience
- Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, and/or GIS tools
- Strong knowledge of Australian standards and local planning frameworks
- Design, drafting and technical support for landscape projects on a variety of project sizes and complexities
- Excellent communication and project coordination skills
 -Self-motivated, professional and reliable

A remuneration package between $79,500 to $85,000 per annum + super will be offered to the successful candidate.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit your resume and portfolio outlining your relevant experience - https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17492.php

result.description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen for a Vocationally Registered (VR) or restricted General Practitioner to join a thriving, state-of-the-art medical centre located in the family-friendly suburb of Burwood East, Victoria. This modern, mixed-billing clinic is situated within a bustling shopping precinct just 25 minutes from Melbourne’s CBD, offering an enviable balance of suburban charm and metropolitan convenience. With high patient demand and a rapidly growing local population, an incoming doctor will step into a fully booked schedule from day one, stepping into a vibrant practice environment that perfectly balances clinical autonomy with comprehensive organizational backing. 

 The practice boasts a highly collaborative team composition and a sophisticated infrastructure designed to optimize patient care and practitioner satisfaction. Operating with a robust support network, the incoming GP will work alongside dedicated administrative staff, experienced practice nurses, and structured Chronic Disease Management (CDM) support to streamline daily workflows. The facility is equipped with modern, spacious consultation rooms, a fully resourced treatment room, and utilizes leading software systems including Best Practice and HotDoc. Practitioners also benefit from the seamless convenience of onsite pathology and a diverse network of allied health professionals, all overseen by a supportive, GP-led leadership team. 

 Financially and professionally, this role offers an outstanding package tailored to recognize experience and dedication. The successful candidate will receive an attractive 75% of billings, alongside a generous guarantee of $200 per hour for the first three months to ensure a smooth and secure transition. For restricted GPs, the clinic provides a viable pathway through an eligible 6-month locum exemption, with broader opportunities available for those interested in exploring special interest areas, ongoing CPD support, or stepping into supervisor roles. Flexible working arrangements are highly encouraged, allowing doctors to choose between full-time, part-time, or locum commitments to suit their personal schedules. 

 Beyond the clinic walls, the location offers exceptional lifestyle benefits that make it a highly desirable place to work and live. Burwood East is renowned for its excellent community amenities, including close proximity to prestigious schooling options like Mount Waverley Secondary College and a variety of beautiful local parks and reserves. Medical networking and secondary care referrals are made easy with Waverley Private Hospital located just ten minutes away. With seamless public transport links and ample onsite parking, this position represents the ideal intersection of high earning potential, premium clinical facilities, and a vibrant, supportive community.   Apply Now

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Revenue Policy Analyst





Job no: 944998

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Administration, Business and Management, Information-Communication Technology, Policy




 

Department for Health and Wellbeing - Commissioning and Performance - Activity Based Management and Funding

Salary: $116,089 to $125,490 - ASO7 - Full Time - Ongoing - Permanent

Overview:

The Revenue Policy Analyst is responsible for the development of revenue policy and strategy within the newly established Revenue Strategy Unit (RS). This is a great opportunity for team members currently working within Local Health Networks (LHNs) to contribute to system-wide policy development and gain experience within the Department. 

The unit supports and manages key policy initiatives designed to support the optimisation of revenue outcomes for public health services. The unit's purpose is to provide system leadership, though policy and guidance to revenue-based teams working across the Local Health Networks, who are responsible for optimising revenue outcomes and meeting revenue compliance requirements. It achieves this through:

The development and maintenance of policies and guidelines (policy and governance).

Strategy, education, and business reform across all patient revenue streams.

The provision of a level 2 helpdesk, supporting Local Health Networks to get policy and practice right every time.

Commonwealth department and jurisdictional consultation and engagement on system wide issues-matters.

Periodic and ad hoc Revenue Compliance reviews.

The Revenue Policy Analyst will be involved in funding matters and audits and the provision of expert policy related advice to Local Health Networks (LHNs) to ensure that SA Health policies are implemented and adhered to.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Job ref: 944998

Criminal History Screening Requirement

A 'National Police Certificate' NPC (also known as a 'Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check' NCCHC) for employment involving no contact with vulnerable groups is required for this position (general employment).

Immunisation Risk for this position is (minimal patient contact).

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

Position Classification: Visiting Medical Officer

Requisition ID: REQ679373

This successful candidate for this position can be based in a metro area with the expectation to visit Broken Hill Correctional Centre in Broken Hill, NSW at least once a month.

.

Are you looking to make a difference?

We are Just the Place to grow your career and be part of a valued team delivering care where it is needed most.

An exciting opportunity is available for a Visiting Medical Officer - Primary Care to join our service at the Justice Health and Forensic Mental Health Network.

We are looking for a qualified health care professional with:

.Current medical registration with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA).

.Fellowship of the Royal Australian College of General Practice (FRACGP) OR Australasian College of Rural and Remote Medicine (FACRRM).

.Proof of recognition as a specialist by the Specialists Recognition Advisory Committee Award.

.Demonstrated significant experience in General Practice with knowledge of contemporary clinical management and modern approaches in assessment and management of the broad range of acute and chronic medical conditions.

.Previous experience in emergency medicine, general practice, adult internal medicine, or rural medicine is an advantage.

The Visiting Medical Officer - Primary Care is responsible for the provision of general medical services to patients within correctional environments in Justice Health and Forensic Mental Health Network facilities. The position will work collaboratively with the Nursing Unit Manager (NUM), Service Director Primary Care and Clinical Director Primary Care to enhance the existing services in line with organisational needs and best practice.

 

Our Team and Service

The Justice Health and Forensic Mental Health Network is a state-wide specialty health network with a vision: 

We excel in patient-centred care across community, inpatient and custodial settings. We deliver healthier tomorrows and transform the lives of some of the most vulnerable adolescents and adults across NSW.

Be part of a supportive environment where you can apply your skills to address complex healthcare needs while training and broadening your treatment capabilities to maximise patient outcomes. With industry-leading safety standards, you can focus on doing your best work alongside skilled colleagues.

 

Salary & Benefits

Your salary as per the NSW Health - Remuneration Rates for Sessional Visiting Medical Officers (click to view) directive is just the beginning.

You'll also have access to:

.A Fitness Passport (if you're eligible)

.Access to Salary Packaging benefits

.Support from a passionate & enthusiastic management team

.Fantastic training & education opportunities available

.Genuine career progression & professional development opportunities

 

 

Inclusivity & Diversity

We're working with JobAccess and the National Disability Recruitment Coordinator (NDRC) to remove barriers in our recruitment process and build a more inclusive workplace. If you require any adjustments to take part in this recruitment process, we're happy to discuss them with you.
